summary.text: Zakir Choudhury, a People First Party licensed CPA, parent and community organizer, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Assembly District 87 to incumbent Karines Reyes.
He lost the Democratic primary for the seat to Reyes, 71.6% to 28.1%, and remained on the November ballot on the People First Party line.
His campaign website describes him as a first-generation American.

paragraphs.text: Zakir Choudhury describes himself on his campaign website as a first-generation American, a licensed CPA and a parent who has lived and raised his family in the district for years.
The website says his candidacy is shaped by decades of professional experience helping families, seniors and small businesses navigate financial challenges, and by his work as a community organizer.
During the campaign, he ran on accountability, affordability and public safety themes, according to his campaign website.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Choudhury lost to Karines Reyes, according to unofficial results from the NYC Board of Elections and Wikipedia.
